document.abstract: This paper gives an overview of the performance of DVB-T in the case of mobile reception. Failure point criteria to assess the systems performance are explained. Results of laboratory measurements and field trials performed within the ACTS project MOTIVATE are presented. The limits of mobile DVB-T reception are explained. Conclusion will be made for the choice of suitable modes for mobile applications.
